mapper.sql: id, sync_type, sync_time, status, error_message, data_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sync_record ( sync_type, sync_time, status, error_message, processed_count ) VALUES ( #{syncType}, #{syncTime}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{processedCount} )

INSERT INTO sync_record ( sync_type, sync_time, status, error_message, data_count, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.syncType}, #{item.syncTime}, #{item.status}, #{item.errorMessage}, #{item.dataCount}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sync_record ORDER BY sync_time DESC
SELECT FROM sync_record WHERE sync_type = #{syncType} ORDER BY sync_time DESC

SELECT id, sync_type as syncType, sync_time as syncTime, status, error_message as errorMessage, processed_count as processedCount FROM sync_record WHERE sync_type = #{syncType} ORDER BY sync_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM sync_record WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY sync_time DESC
SELECT FROM sync_record WHERE sync_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} ORDER BY sync_time DESC
